[[Turnback Cave]] }} '''The Final Dimensional Duel VII''' (Japanese: '''異次元決戦VII''' ''Different Dimension Battle VII''), titled '''Alternate Dimension Showdown VII''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 437th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 21st chapter of the {{MangaArc|Platinum}}. It is subtitled '''The World of Antimatter''' (Japanese: '''反物質の世界''' ''Antimatter World'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Antimatter World''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} Continuing their {{pkmn|battle}}, [[Mira]] faces [[Saturn]], while [[Cheryl]] battles [[Mars]], and [[Marley]] battles [[Jupiter]]. [[Saturn's Toxicroak]] attacks with her knuckle claw, but Mira's {{p|Alakazam}} blocks it with its spoon and uses {{m|Power Trick}}. A confused Saturn points out that Mira is just switching her Alakazam's Attack and Defense stats. Mira follows up by having Alakazam use {{m|Guard Swap}}, which Saturn notes is swapping its Special Defense with its Defense stat; this confuses Saturn, as this removes the [[Type#Type effectiveness|advantage]] a {{type|Psychic}} Pokémon has against his {{p|Toxicroak}}. Saturn questions Mira about this, while simultaneously attacking with {{m|Poison Jab}}. In her head, Mira reveals that she intends to draw out their battle and wants to make sure Saturn won't be able to deal much [[damage]]. On Mars's side, she commands her {{p|Yanmega}} to attack Cheryl's {{p|Blissey}} with {{m|Bug Buzz}}. Blissey attempts to recover some of her health with a [[Berry]], but Yanmega steals and eats the Berry with {{m|Bug Bite}}. Cheryl counters this by having Blissey {{m|Sing}} to put Yanmega to {{status|sleep}}. Mars switches for her {{p|Bronzor}} and prevents Blissey from healing herself with {{m|Heal Block}}. On Jupiter's side, she attacks Marley's {{p|Arcanine}} with an {{type|Electric}} {{m|Natural Gift}}, which {{adv|Platinum}} recognizes instantly. Jupiter hands {{p|Tangrowth}} a [[Durin Berry]] and has it use a {{type|Water}} Natural Gift to attack Arcanine. When Marley wonders how the [[move]] could be a different [[type]], Platinum throws her a [[Vs. Recorder]]. Marley checks the Vs. Recorder and figures out something. Jupiter has Tangrowth use a {{type|Ground}} Natural Gift with a [[Hondew Berry]], but Marley manages to get Arcanine to dodge the attack. Jupiter prepares a [[Magost Berry]] for a {{type|Rock}} Natural Gift, but Marley manages to get her Arcanine to dodge the falling rocks. Jupiter realizes that Marley is now predicting her attacks. [[Palmer]] asks Platinum what she handed to Marley. Platinum reveals to Palmer that she lost to Jupiter and her Tangrowth's Natural Gift before. Since then, she figured out the secret to the attack and recorded it on her Vs. Recorder. She adds that with a [[Rawst Berry]], the move's type changes to {{t|Grass}}, but with a [[Lum Berry]], the move deals {{type|Flying}} damage. Palmer notes that there is also {{p|Arceus|a Pokémon that can}} [[Type change|change its type]] {{a|Multitype|using}} [[Plate|an item]]. Before he can think about this any further, something appears and tackles him away. The [[Advanced level Grunt]] takes note of the thing that knocked Palmer away and realizes that the assailant is {{p|Darkrai}}. Elsewhere, {{adv|Diamond}} examines his surroundings and realizes that he has wound up in the [[Distortion World]]. A voice from above asks Diamond how he knows that he's in the Distortion World. Diamond answers by stating that it's because this is the third time he's touched it. The first was when [[Paka and Uji]] were sucked inside of it, the second is when he and {{p|Mamoswine|Moo}} tried to jump into it at the [[Spear Pillar]], and the third was just [[PS433|a short while ago]] when he took {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Giratina}}'s {{m|Shadow Force}} attack. The voice assumes that because he came in contact with it so many times, it gave Diamond a sort of connection towards the Distortion World. Diamond agrees with the voice and turns towards it, revealing it to be [[Cyrus]]. Meanwhile, {{adv|Pearl}}, the [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman, and [[Dr. Footstep]] arrive at [[Turnback Cave]]. Pearl immediately rushes in to meet up with Platinum. The Chairman follows suit and tells Dr. Footstep to stop getting distracted by the [[footprint]]s. Back in the Distortion World, Diamond asks Cyrus how to counter Giratina. ==Major events== * [[Mira]], [[Cheryl]], and [[Marley]] continue to battle [[Saturn]], [[Mars]], and [[Jupiter]]. * [[Palmer]] is attacked by {{p|Darkrai}}. * {{adv|Diamond}} finds [[Cyrus]] in the [[Distortion World]]. * {{adv|Pearl}}, the [[Sinnoh]] [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman, and [[Dr. Footstep]] arrive at [[Turnback Cave]] and go inside. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} * {{adv|Platinum}} * [[Palmer]] * [[Cyrus]] * [[Mars]] * [[Saturn]] * [[Jupiter]] * [[Marley]] * [[Mira]] * [[Cheryl]] * [[Advanced level Grunt]] * Sinnoh [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman * [[Dr. Footstep]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Mamoswine}} (Moo; {{adv|Diamond}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Bronzor}} ([[Mars]]'s) * {{p|Yanmega}} ([[Mars]]'s) * {{p|Tangrowth}} ([[Jupiter]]'s) * {{p|Toxicroak}} ({{OP|Saturn|Toxicroak}}) * {{p|Alakazam}} ([[Mira]]'s) * {{p|Blissey}} ([[Cheryl]]'s) * {{p|Arcanine}} ([[Marley]]'s) * {{p|Darkrai}} * {{p|Shaymin}} ({{form|Shaymin|Land Forme}}) * {{P|Arceus}} ({{adv|Arceus|Adventures}}; fantasy) ==In other languages== {{translation notice|Chinese or Korean}} {{Epilang|color=BBBBBB|bordercolor=999999 |zh_cmn={{tt|異次元決戰 VII|}} |fr=Un monde d'antimatière |de=Kampf in verschiedenen Dimensionen (Teil 7) |it=Scontro dimensionale VII |ko={{tt|VS 이차원 결전VII|}} |es_la=VS Último combate dimensional VII - El mundo antimateria |es_eu=La batalla interdimensional VII |vi=Quyết chiến ở chiều không gian khác VII - Thế giới phản vật chất }} {{-}} {{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS436 |prevtitle=The Final Dimensional Duel VI |nextcode=PS438 |nexttitle=The Final Dimensional Duel VIII |series=Platinum |colorscheme=Platinum}} {{Project Manga notice}} [[de:Finale in der anderen Dimension VII]] [[es:PMS437]] [[fr:Chapitre 437 (Pocket Monsters Special)]] [[it:LGA437]] [[zh:宝可梦特别篇 第437话]]
